title: NATS request/reply runner.plugins.key.<host> (studio → the host's supervising runner)
description: From API 1.73 (contracts/README.md, Plugins: a key from its host). Core NATS request/reply on subject `runner.plugins.key.<host>` (no queue group: the one runner of that host with RUNNER_PLUGINS on), bare JSON. Add as provider without a key, for a plugin whose manifest has `provider.key_from`: the runner finds the plugin in its own plugin folders (as it does to start it; its `run.host` must be this host), reads only the variable `key_from.var` from the file `key_from.file` directly in $HELM_HOME (a regular file, not a symlink, named `<plugin>.`…; anything else is refused) and replies with its value. The reply carries a key: core request/reply only, never on a stream, never logged, never in an event, error or HTTP response. Studio waits 5 s.

error.description: why, in plain words (never the key)

code.description: not_found: no such plugin in its folders, or its manifest has no key_from; no_key: the file or the variable is not there yet (it makes its key on first start); refused: the file is outside $HELM_HOME, a symlink, not named after the plugin, or the plugin's run is for another host
